en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
Drinking green tea after a meal
Sleeping after a meal
Exercising after a meal

I wonder why tea after a meal is so
relaxing.

Like listening to classical music...
It makes me happy to be alive.

I know it's not okay to do, but sometimes
I just wanna lie down on my side and nap.
My mom used to scold me all the time...

Oh, do you remember? We talked about
going over to my place to play the piano.

I'll introduce you to my mom when
you do.
Well, I know that's healthy and all...
But I always get food coma...
I-I mean, it doesn't matter, right!?

I'll move around after I take a nap, so
I definitely won't get fat!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaede's inner thoughts...?
